messages.subject: Project Cedar — advice note on key risk points (privileged)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Robert and Grace,

Ahead of next week's negotiation I attach a short, privileged advice note on the three points that matter most in the current MSA draft: the exclusivity scope, the product-liability carve-out, and the IPR licence-back. In summary we recommend proceeding, subject to narrowing exclusivity, confirming the aviation products insurance, and tightening the licence-back in Halstead's favour.

Elena has confirmed your £30m aviation products cover satisfies the contractual requirement. Happy to talk it through before the 26th.

Kind regards,
James

James Osei | Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James — very clear, thank you. We agree with the three priorities. On the cap, we could live with a modest first-year floor if it gets the deal done. Please push hard on exclusivity; that's the one that affects the rest of the order book.

Grace
